gaps.where: Settings → Workspace, "Your page" card: the full link with "Copy the link" and Open (and every booking or calendar link the person asks for)
gaps.gap: No read gives a whole public link. Read tools get only (db, ctx, args), and ToolContext has no webUrl (runtime.ts:91-98), so get_settings cannot build an origin. business returns workspace.get, and booking_site returns booking_site.get, whose only address is path "/book/<slug>" (calendar.ts:1068). manage_booking_site's card and outcome also give only "/book/<slug>" (tools-settings-calendar.ts:939, 968). The only sample link the model sees is https://handsfreeos.com/book/acme (prompt.ts:49), but the real origin is https://app.handsfreeos.com (worker fly.toml:45 WEB_URL), or https://<domain> once a branded domain is verified with its certificate. When a branded domain is serving, Your page's link is the domain root with no /book path (page-card.tsx:59). The "handsfreeos.com" wording in manage_web_address (tools-setup.ts:1747, 1797, 1842) and settings-map.ts:141 names the site loosely, not as a URL. It is a lesser fix than the missing link.
gaps.fix: Add webUrl to ToolContext (or pass extra.webUrl to read tools). In tools-settings.ts QUERIES.booking_site, and in the business area through a booking_site.get + branded_domain.get pair, return `link` built the same way as tools-forms.ts:385-389: branded origin when status==='verified' && certificateReady, else webUrl, plus site.path. For Your page, return `pageLink`: the branded origin alone when serving, else webUrl + path, and null when site.page is false. Return the same full link in manage_booking_site's outcome (tools-settings-calendar.ts:968). Change prompt.ts:49's example to a neutral https://acme.com/book.

gaps.where: Settings → Usage & balance, the Top up button (and the phone's Usage & balance)
gaps.gap: The SYSTEM prompt's list of things only the person can do includes "topping up their balance" and tells the model to call settings_help (prompt.ts:34). settings_help's own description says the same (tools.ts:360). The Assistant can in fact top up: wallet.top_up is a SCREEN_ACTION (coverage.ts:161), SETTING_TOOLS maps usage.balance to do_wallet_top_up (coverage.ts:561), and usage.canChange includes "top up the balance now, from the card on file" (settings-map.ts:808). Only the auto top-up tool's description says top-ups go through do_wallet_top_up (tools-billing.ts:318), and the model doesn't see it unless that tool is loaded.
gaps.fix: In prompt.ts:34 and tools.ts:360, replace "topping up their balance" with "adding or changing the card on file". Add to prompt.ts:34: "a top-up from the card on file is do_wallet_top_up, on a card".

gaps.where: Settings → Deleted bin: each row's name, kind, "Deleted by X on <date>", what went with it, "Being deleted now", and Show more
gaps.gap: bin.list returns deletedBy, emptying, contents and nextCursor (bin.ts:97-112). The deleted_bin shape keeps only id, kind, name, deletedAt and purgeAfter (tools-settings.ts:104-128). It drops who deleted each item, though settings-map onScreen promises "who deleted it" (settings-map.ts:304). It also drops "Being deleted now" and what went with each item, returns the raw kind (custom_record, appointment), and gives no sign that more items exist past the first page of 50 (crm.ts:16). restore_from_bin pages through every item (tools-settings-more.ts:413-429), but its binItemId has to come from that capped list. Severity is lowered: most businesses' 30-day bin holds under 50 items, and nothing can be lost.
gaps.fix: In the tools-settings.ts deleted_bin shape, add per item: deletedBy: i.deletedBy?.name ?? null, beingDeletedNow: i.emptying, kind: binKindLabel(i), and detail: binItemDetail(i, timezone) from packages/core/src/bin-words.ts:278-290. Return { items, more: nextCursor !== null }. Either add `name`/`cursor` inputs to get_settings for deleted_bin, or let restore_from_bin take a name and search all pages, as binItemOf already does.

gaps.where: Settings → Workspace: the "Logo and colour", "Your page" (link and Show your page switch) and "Getting started guide" cards
gaps.gap: Two cards are real gaps. "Logo and colour" and "Your page" are not in business.onScreen or business.canChange (settings-map.ts:125-133), and "Your page" appears nowhere in the settings map. The tools exist: do_look_set, do_look_find and do_booking_site_set_page (coverage.ts:143-144,212,502-506). Uploading a logo is NEVER (coverage.ts:397), and no handover says where to do it. The Getting started guide part is already covered: places-map.ts:48 names "Settings → Workspace, Getting started guide", and do_onboarding_set_enabled is mapped (coverage.ts:507).
gaps.fix: Add to business.onScreen: "Logo and colour: Upload a logo, Find it from my website, Remove, and the colour", "Your page: Show your page switch, the link with Copy the link and Open" and "Getting started guide". Add to business.canChange: "the business colour, finding the logo from its website, or taking the logo off" and "show or hide the one-page site (Your page)". Add a handover { what: 'upload a logo', why: 'it is a picture from your own computer or phone', steps: ['Open Settings → Workspace.', 'In Logo and colour, press Upload a logo and pick the picture.'] }.

gaps.where: Settings → Automations, intake panel: the "Intake message" box with Save and "Use the standard wording"
gaps.gap: update_automations has intakeFormId but no input for the message (tools-extra.ts core:285-410). list_automations returns only the intake form's name (worker tools-extra.ts:754-756). The screen edits intake.message, with Save and the standard wording (panels.tsx:884-900; automations/settings.ts:107-118). The only way to read it is the raw workspace.settings.automations.intake.message inside get_settings(business), which exists only after the Automations page has been saved once. Nothing points the model there.
gaps.fix: In listAutomations (worker tools-extra.ts:754), return intake: { form, message: a.intake.message, standard: a.intake.message === DEFAULT_INTAKE_MESSAGE }. Add intakeMessage: text(480).nullable().optional() to update_automations, with null meaning DEFAULT_INTAKE_MESSAGE, validated with intakeMessageProblem. Plan it in planAutomations as intake: { ...now.intake, message }, and show it on the card as "Intake message".

gaps.where: Settings → Automations, maintenance panel: days before it is due, days between each step, at most a day
gaps.gap: The maintenance panel sets leadDays, secondAfterDays and maxPerDay (panels.tsx:1027-1060; settings.ts:133-137). list_automations returns only template and planTemplate (worker tools-extra.ts:766), and update_automations has no input for any of the three. They are reachable only as raw settings.automations.maintenance through get_settings(business), after a save. These rows have no setting= key, which is why the coverage test never flagged them.
gaps.fix: In listAutomations, return maintenanceDue: { message, planMessage, daysBefore: leadDays, daysBetween: secondAfterDays, mostPerDay: maxPerDay }. Add to update_automations maintenanceDaysBefore: z.int().min(0).max(60), maintenanceDaysBetween: z.int().min(1).max(30) and maintenanceMostPerDay: z.int().min(1).max(200), merged into maintenance at tools-extra.ts:1002-1030. Add setting keys to the three panel rows so coverage checks them.

gaps.where: Settings → Automations, "Text leads that went quiet": the owner-only "Looks good, turn on"
gaps.gap: update_action_center_settings blocks followUpOnQuietLeads=true until nudgeReviewedAt is set (tools-settings-money.ts:699-725). Re-engage dead leads, which has the same review-first shape, shows its message on the card, and Confirm counts as Looks good, turn on (worker tools-extra.ts:870-882, 1114-1117). docs/operations.md:6970 records the owner's decision that every Automations row can be done this way. The screen keeps this to owners ("Chris's rule": an owner reads the words; panels.tsx:1384, 1423, 1579-1590). Any fix must keep that gate. The re-engage path doesn't check for an owner either.
gaps.fix: In tools-settings-money.ts prepare: when followUpOnQuietLeads===true and nudgeReviewedAt is null, and the person is an owner, put next.nudge.template on the card as a "Follow-up wording" field with the caution "Read the wording above: saving is your Looks good, turn on." In commit, set auto.nudgeReviewedAt = now. For a non-owner, keep the block, reworded as "An owner turns follow-ups on after reading the wording." Add the same owner check to the reengage readFirst branch (tools-extra.ts:870).

gaps.where: Settings → Automations, "Text leads that went quiet": one gone-quiet box per open stage
gaps.gap: Changing it is a real gap. update_action_center_settings sets only stale.days (goneQuietAfterDays, tools-settings-money.ts:610). The screen keeps a number per open stage in stale.stageDays (panels.tsx:1612-1623), and SETTING_TOOLS maps adjust.gone_quiet to the overall number only (coverage.ts:542). The card says "Gone quiet after N days" without saying that stages with their own number keep it. Reading it is not a gap: get_settings(action_center) returns attention.settings unshaped, stale.stageDays included, keyed by stage id, and the context lists stage ids and names.
gaps.fix: Add goneQuietByStage: z.array(z.object({ stageId: uuid, days: z.int().min(1).max(365).nullable() })).max(50) to update_action_center_settings. null, or days equal to stale.days, deletes the override, as setStale does. On the card, list each stage's change by name. When goneQuietAfterDays changes while overrides exist, add a note: "<stage> keeps its own N days."

gaps.where: Phone app → More → Settings: the "This business" section (Usage & balance, Main offer, Partners), Face ID, Businesses on this phone, My safety
gaps.gap: The SYSTEM sentence is wrong. It says the phone's Settings holds only notifications, appearance and their cell (prompt.ts:38). But the prompt's own PHONE_APP list already says the phone's Settings has My cell phone, Face ID, Businesses on this phone and Usage & balance (places-map.ts:626), so the model gets two contradicting lines. Neither mentions Main offer or Partners, which show under This business (mobile settings/index.tsx:228-246). My safety is named in settings-map.ts:1021.
gaps.fix: In prompt.ts:38, replace "the phone app's Settings holds only the person's own things (notifications, appearance, their cell), and the business is set up on the web" with "the phone app's own Settings is listed under The phone app below; the rest of the business is set up on the web". In places-map.ts:626, add "My safety, and under This business: Usage & balance, Main offer and Partners (while an add-on that uses them is on)".

gaps.where: Settings → Fields: Move up / Move down on each field
gaps.gap: The screen reorders fields with custom_field.update { position } (fields-settings.tsx:71-88). manage_custom_field has no position input (core tools-setup.ts:82-104), and the worker's commit never sends position (worker tools-setup.ts:674-683).
gaps.fix: Add 'move' to manage_custom_field's action enum, with `order: uuid[]` (every field of that record type, in order). At commit, renumber from 0 and call custom_field.update { customFieldId, position } only for the fields whose position changes, as fields-settings.tsx move() does. The card shows Order: A → B → C.

gaps.where: Settings → Fields, a choice field's choices: editing a choice's label
gaps.gap: optionsFor matches choices by label (worker tools-setup.ts:469-474), so a renamed choice gets a new value. The card shows the old label under "Taken off" with "stays on the records that already have it" (tools-setup.ts:613-626), and records with the old value no longer match any choice. The screen keeps ChoiceDraft.value when a label is edited, so records keep their answer (fields-settings.tsx:227-231, 247-249).
gaps.fix: Add renameChoices: z.array(z.object({ from: text(60), to: text(60) })).max(50).optional() to manage_custom_field. In optionsFor, keep the value of the option labelled `from` under the new `to` label. On the card, show "Renamed: Old → New" and leave renamed choices out of "Taken off".

gaps.where: Settings → Pipelines, a stage's Edit dialog: the Kind select (open, won, lost)
gaps.gap: rename_stage commits stageKind (tools-settings-business.ts:282-287), but its card shows only Pipeline, Now and Was (215-226), so a kind change goes through unseen. The description doesn't say rename_stage can change a stage's kind (tools.ts:536), and neither does pipelines.canChange (settings-map.ts:244). archive_pipeline's card says "nothing new can be added to it", where the screen says "It disappears from the board; its won and lost leads keep their history" (pipelines-editor.tsx:80). The delete card falls back to "the first stage" (tools-settings-business.ts:236). The screen defaults to the first stage of the same kind (pipelines-editor.tsx:417-418), and stage.delete refuses when leads exist and no target is given (stage.delete.ts:36-40).
gaps.fix: In the rename_stage card, add { label: 'Counts as', value } and a Was row whenever stageKind differs from found.stage.kind. Retitle it "Change <stage>", and refuse when leadCount>0, saying "A stage with leads keeps its kind. Move the leads out first." Add "rename_stage can also change what it counts as (open, won, lost)" to the manage_pipeline description, and "change what a stage counts as" to pipelines.canChange. Reword the archive note to the screen's words. In delete_stage, default to the first other stage of the same kind, or block when leads exist and there is no target.

gaps.where: Settings → Deleted bin, who can see it
gaps.gap: readArea adds the same note to every hidden part: "Not this person's to see… An owner or admin can." (tools-settings.ts:290-292). deleted_bin needs records.delete, which only owners have by default (permissions.ts:35-37; admin's list has no records.delete). Owner-only permissions.manage (the permissions area) is wrong the same way. An admin is told that an admin can.
gaps.fix: Add `whoCan` to SettingsAreaInfo, or work it out from info.permission and ROLE_PERMISSIONS: "an owner" when only owners hold it, otherwise "an owner or admin". For deleted_bin, override it to "an owner, or someone an owner gave Delete for good to". Use it in the note at tools-settings.ts:291.

gaps.where: Settings → Workspace, the business form: Website and Review link (clearing them, and the other saved links)
gaps.gap: website and reviewLink are z.url().optional() (tools.ts:524-525), so neither can be cleared. The screen saves an empty box as null (workspace-form.tsx:62-67). The commit writes settings.links = { review } (tools-settings-business.ts:134), and workspace.update merges settings only one level deep (workspace.update.ts:33), so links is replaced whole. Today review is the only key anyone writes under links (workspace-form.tsx:66, onboarding-setup.ts:328), so nothing is lost yet. Severity is lowered for that reason.
gaps.fix: Change both to z.url().max(500).nullable().optional() (null clears). In the commit, read workspace.settings.links and write links: { ...now.links, review: args.reviewLink }, and website: args.website as given, null included, rather than through str(). On the card, show "None" for a cleared value.

gaps.where: Settings → Account, Side menu → Edit menu: Move up/down, Add group, naming a group, moving a place into a group, Ungroup
gaps.gap: arrange_my_menu's actions are hide, show, use_suggested and start_over (tools-extra.ts:421-434). The sheet also moves entries up and down, moves a place into a group, adds, renames and ungroups groups (menu-editor.tsx:12-17, 187-192, 215-289). Yet the prompt tells people they may have "moved or grouped" a place (prompt.ts:38).
gaps.fix: Add actions to arrange_my_menu: move (place, before/after a place or group), group (name, places; at most MENU_GROUPS_MAX), rename_group (group, name) and ungroup (group). Apply them with core's moveKey, renameGroup and ungroup from packages/core/src/account/menu.ts, and save through the same menu setting.

gaps.where: Phone app → Settings → Appearance (this phone only)
gaps.gap: The phone keeps its appearance in deviceStore and ignores the account's (mobile lib/appearance.ts:9-10, 26-31). Its row carries settingKey account.appearance (mobile settings/index.tsx:285), which SETTING_TOOLS maps to update_my_account, and that writes the account theme (tools-settings-me.ts:105). The model can't tell a phone asker from a web one (context.ts has no surface field).
gaps.fix: Change the update_my_account description to "whether the web app is light or dark (the phone app keeps its own, in More → Settings → Appearance)". Give the phone row its own key, phone.appearance, in SETTINGS_NEVER, with the reason "kept on the phone itself: More → Settings → Appearance".

gaps.gap: list_automations' calls section returns voicemail, hours, tries and askConsent but not businessLandlines (worker tools-extra.ts:758-765), which update_automations does change (998-1001). It is reachable only as raw settings.automations.calls.businessLandlines through get_settings(business), which returns workspace.settings unshaped, and only after the Automations page has been saved once. gaps.fix: Add callsBusinessLandlines: a.calls.businessLandlines to listAutomations' result, next to asksForOkToCall (tools-extra.ts:765).

gaps.where: Settings → Tags, "What the AI changed lately"
gaps.gap: ai_tagging_status asks contact_ai.reviews for limit 10 (tools-contacts.ts:131-138). The page asks for 15 (tags/page.tsx:27-28) and has no Show more of its own, so the two lists differ by 5 rows. gaps.where: Settings → Deleted bin, the page's own description and the kind on each row
gaps.gap: deleted_bin.what says "customers, conversations and bookings" (settings-map.ts:301). The screen's BIN_WORDS.about and move_to_bin also cover leads, companies and records (bin-words.ts:83; tools-settings-more.ts:58). restore_from_bin's card labels the kind with its own KIND_WORDS, which says "Appointment" where the screen says "Booking" and "Record" where the screen gives the custom record's own kind (tools-settings-more.ts:402-409, 444).
gaps.fix: Set deleted_bin.what to 'customers, conversations, bookings, leads, companies and records deleted for good, kept 30 days so they can be brought back, then gone' (BIN_WORDS.about's list). In restore_from_bin, delete KIND_WORDS and label the card field binKindLabel(item) from bin-words.ts:278. That needs contents added to the local BinItem type.

gaps.where: Settings → Usage & balance: the founding plan card above the balance (renewing on or off, Pay with another card after a refused renewal)
